info.name: Common Room Core Activities Locations API

items.docs: Retrieve a specific location by its unique identifier.

params.name: locationType
params.description: The granularity of locations to return (required)

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of locations to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of meta columns. The meta column `recordCount`
can be requested to return the total number of matching locations in
`meta.recordCount`.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of locations, sorted by member count (descending).
